name: Ig2_Sphere_ChainedCylinder_CylScGeom6D
description: Create/update a ScGeom6D instance representing the geometry of a contact point between two Spheres<Sphere>, including relative rotations.

attributes.name: updateRotations
attributes.description: Precompute relative rotations. Turning this false can speed up simulations when rotations are not needed in constitutive laws (e.g. when spheres are compressed without cohesion and moment in early stage of a triaxial test), but is not foolproof. Change this value only if you know what you are doing.

attributes.name: creep
attributes.description: Substract rotational creep from relative rotation. The rotational creep twistCreep is a quaternion and has to be updated inside a constitutive law, see for instance Law2_ScGeom6D_CohFrictPhys_CohesionMoment.

attributes.name: interactionDetectionFactor
attributes.description: Enlarge both radii by this factor (if >1), to permit creation of distant interactions.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.
